summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed). mypy, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore comments and formatting were checked by reading only. Lines in both new files are within 88 columns. Steps 3–7 of the workflow run only for blank nodes, so None and plain strings fall through to SHACLPathError rather than acting as a wildcard. No existing modules changed and nothing was committed.
